race.description: Beachfront Bar & Grill @ Port City Bowling Club Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: KEN'KER (10) led them up over further at Bowraville last time out and drops back to this trip where he was sound two back at Kempsey when the race favourite in easier company. Has the speed to lead from the outset and has placed at this track and trip. Will be tough to run down. UNDER TWENTY TWO (8) resumed in good order over this course and distance, sitting handy and scoring in this grade by 0.2L when negotiating a wide draw. Still drawn a little tricky, but he's back to his best for the new stable and he does improve with racing. Can raise the bar. AYE AYE SKIPPER (9) finished behind UNDER TWENTY TWO last start here and now hits this third-up where he is a winner in the past. Has placed 3/5 at this track and trip and can make an impression. BJORN IRONSIDE (5) won't be far away is he runs up to his recent form.
